SIX COMMITS ON develop, NONE PUSHED; the push-gate sweep is RUNNING). develop local = ac3d9601e, origin/develop = 44b7fc604, master = b2b486a79 (v0.100.0 published). || WHAT LANDED, in order: (1) 64eba48dd test(lanes): the two UNOWNED lanes joined the fast tier. gui existed only as an inline body inside remote_build.sh's gui stage — nothing could invoke it by name, so nothing re-ran it (the same shape that let c-torture drift five weeks). It is scripts/gui_lane.sh now: webview build + header check + Xvfb + three passes + a zero-tests guard, and NO xvfb-run on the host is rc=2 (an ERROR, never a skip). remote_build.sh's gui stage calls it; a new `fastlanes` stage runs the whole tier from the NAS with MADC_FAST_NO_RECORD=1 (a row written on the rsync copy gates nothing — record on the NAS). fast_lanes.sh now runs c-testsuite, c-torture, c2mir-tests, gui, gxx-c++11: MEASURED 4+28+5+51+86s, under three minutes, so the header's stale `~4min` for c-torture is corrected. docs/lane-status.tsv gained a c2mir-tests row (promote=commit) and gui moved yes -> commit. || THEN FIVE DEFECTS, each its own commit with a reducer verified against BOTH gcc and clang: (2) c4d9446ea fix(parser): an anonymous struct/union member may be cv-qualified. THREE member-list readers exist; only two consumed a leading qualifier run and the anon-body reader consumed NONE, so `union { const char *asm_str; MIR_item_t item; } u;` was 'Expecting type in anonymous struct definition'. One member list stopping early takes every member after it, which is why c2mir.c reported 113 'no member named c2m_ctx' (the LAST member of that same struct) and one parse error 6000 lines earlier. All three now call the ONE owner skip_cv_qualifier_tokens in both positions; the outer loop also gains `restrict`, and `mutable` stays local to it (a storage class, not a cv). 119 -> 114. tests/testanonunioncv.mad. (3) 510491e03 fix(lexer): blue paint (C11 6.10.3.4p2) survives a macro ARGUMENT's pre-expansion. madc's paint is a name on the pushback FRAME; an argument is pre-expanded in a throwaway Source whose frames die before the outer replacement is pushed, so `#define str_tab c2m_ctx->str_tab` reached the rescan through HTAB_CREATE as `&(c2m_ctx->c2m_ctx->str_tab)` — 551 double expansions in c2mir.c, 109 hard errors. The frame now carries the SET of names the argument consumed. ⚠️ THE FILTER MUST BE TRANSITIVE: glibc's __MATHCALL_VEC does not mention _Mdouble_ but the __MATHCALL in its body does, so a one-level filter painted it and left `extern _Mdouble_ acos (double __x)` — 109 c2mir.c errors became 150 math.h errors, i.e. EVERY C program. The walk follows the bodies the body reaches, bounded + visited-set, and answers 'do not paint' when unsure. 114 -> 13. KNOWN-OPEN, written in tests/testmacroselfref.mad: a name the argument expanded AND the replacement spells itself cannot be told apart by a per-frame paint — that overlap keeps the pre-fix behaviour and needs per-token hide sets. (4) b8d1a87c0 fix(parser): a cast's deref operand may itself be a cast. `(uint64_t) * (uint32_t *) v` (mir-hash.h:39) refused with 'Expecting identifier' while the SAME deref without the outer cast compiled — two paths, one owner: parse_cast_unary_deref_operand hand-rolled what parse_deref_paren_operand owns (cast head vs statement expression vs plain parens). tests/testcastderefcast.mad carries the negative control in the same file: `(uint64_t)a * (uint64_t)b` is MULTIPLICATION. (5) 273d8168c fix(lexer): a macro argument's leading NEWLINE is whitespace, not a token. A wrapped call hands the argument after the break a leading newline and `##` pasted across it, so mir.h's REP8/REP10-built insn enum lost MIR_VURSHI64 / MIR_VRSHVI32 / MIR_VEQF32 — it reads as 'three random enum members are missing'. THREE copies of the argument trim existed, all three stopping at space and tab; one owner now (trim_macro_argument). tests/testmacroargwrap.mad. (6) ac3d9601e fix(lexer): the hide set belongs to the EXPANSION, not one frame's name. Two corrections found by following (3) down: the paint must be reported UPWARD (three levels deep — every `assert (VARR_GET (char, cs->ln, 0))` in c2mir.c is three — only the innermost level knew), and a macro is NOT hidden while its OWN arguments are pre-expanded (C11 6.10.3.1p1: replaced before substitution, hidden only for the RESCAN; `NL_HEAD (NL_HEAD (x))` kept the inner call literal). Runaway recursion stays bounded by the frame-depth backstop at lexer.cpp:6437, which documents itself as the guard for exactly a missed paint. || RATCHETS MOVED (each named in its baseline): c-torture 1611 -> 1612 (20080506-1.c is `MAX ((unsigned int) MAX (i, 0), 1)` — gcc's own regression test for a macro nested in its own argument, failing since the lane was seeded); c2mir-tests 298 -> 302 of 359 (lacc/macro.c, macro-recursive.c, macro-skip-expand.c, new/issue392.c — three named for precisely what was broken); forest_dm 158 -> 146 PP divergences vs g++ -dM, the twelve resolved being kernel-header include guards (_LINUX_TYPES_H, _ASM_GENERIC_TYPES_H, STATX_MNT_ID_UNIQUE...), i.e. madc's PP now takes header branches it used to miss. || ▶ c2mir.c STOPS AT THE NEXT LAYER, which is a DIFFERENT ARC: 0 parse errors, then `c2mir_compile_tree: 139 check errors` on the tree the CIR BUILDER emits — 'request for member u in something not a structure or union', 'lvalue required as left operand of assignment', 'string is too long for array initializer'. known_pre_existing_gaps: SCRIPT `value` IS NOT YET THE 32-BYTE madc_value STRUCT (recorded 2026-08-17, owner: not to be taken on now). Symptom: `value f()` returned BY VALUE emits `int f()` and silently returns nothing (exit 0, empty output) — func_def's return-type arm -> type_list -> append_type_specs has no dtARRAY case and falls through to int. That is why php::print_r returns madc::value & rather than madc::value. CORRECTED PREMISE: a C type DOES exist — madc_value (include/madc_api.h:52) is a tagged 32-byte aligned(16) struct, and madc::value merely CONTAINS it plus two unique_ptr members (32+8+8 = 48 = the emitted long long[6]); the opaque-buffer lowering exists because of those OWNING C++ members, not a missing type. MEASURED: _array/_object are private with no friends and all 40 refs are in ONE file (src/madc_value.cpp) — 12 mutations, 28 reads; the cell finalizer is already wired and called from generated code (cir_builder.cpp:25789/25797); the is_array_object sites would mostly RETIRE. HARD PART: the class deep-copies the containers while the cell path shares, so the migration needs copy-on-write at those 12 sites — a semantic change with its own oracled tests. Full write-up: docs/plans/2026-06-12-type-table-value-abi-design.md section 9. Sibling defect, also open: assigning to a `value &` PARAMETER is wrongly rejected ('assignment of incompatible value').

VLA NOT DEALLOCATED ON BACKWARD GOTO: a `goto` jumping back to before a VLA's declaration must deallocate the VLA (gcc/C semantics; gcc-torture 20040811-1.c). madc lowers VLAs as malloc + __attribute__((cleanup)), which frees only on SCOPE EXIT, not on the backward goto re-entering the scope — so a backward-goto loop over a VLA LEAKS one allocation per iteration. 20040811-1.c leaks ~2GB over 1e6 iterations; it passes only when memory is available (it OOM-SIGSEGV'd when the MIR fork's 128MB code-holder reservation reduced headroom — see mir_fork; arch-gated off x86-64, so it passes again). Proper fix: free the VLA at the backward goto. Separate future slice.

MadArray/MadValue namespacing is an open API/ABI follow-up: moving the real C++ types to madc::array and madc::value would give PHP array helpers a normal namespace type surface, but compatibility aliases alone will not preserve old C++ mangled names.
